Game Overview

In Steve Ball Temple, the core idea is straightforward: guide Steve through a perilous temple where quick reflexes and strategic use of the double-jump are key. Collect stars while bouncing on monsters to clear paths and reach new heights. With each thrilling level, discover hidden shortcuts and achieve star-studded triumph.
